name: AutoHMD Supporting Dataset III
description: AutoHMD Supporting Dataset III This dataset accompanies the manuscript "AutoHMD: Scalable and Accurate Validation of Antibody–Antigen Complexes by Heated Molecular Dynamics". It contains antibody–antigen complex structures and molecular dynamics trajectories used to evaluate Heated Molecular Dynamics (HMD) as a method for binding pose validation. The deposited structural models are provided in PDB format and comprise a benchmark set of antibody–antigen docking poses curated from the AbSet. One pose category is included: Medium-quality poses (medium_poses_pdbs.tar.xz): near-native antibody–antigen complexes used as positive controls for stability assessment. The benchmark includes 30 medium-quality complexes derived from antibody–antigen systems spanning a diverse range of interface characteristics. Companion trajectory datasets contain HMD simulations performed for each structure (medium_packed_traj.tar.xz). For every complex, three independent simulation replicates were generated, each consisting of 5,600 trajectory frames. Due to storage considerations, trajectory files are distributed across separate Zenodo records and will be cross-referenced upon publication. These data were used to evaluate interface stability under thermal perturbation, monitor iRMSD evolution during simulation, optimize pose-classification thresholds, and benchmark the AutoHMD workflow for automated validation of antibody–antigen complexes.
